scope_statement: OCR GCSE English Literature J352, poetry component, 'Youth and Age' cluster of the OCR Poetry Anthology 'Towards a World Unknown' Version 2 (first teaching September 2022). The cluster contains exactly these fifteen poems: 'Holy Thursday' by William Blake; 'The Bluebell' by Anne Bronte; 'Midnight on the Great Western' by Thomas Hardy; 'Out, Out' by Robert Frost; 'Theme for English B' by Langston Hughes; 'Baby Song' by Thom Gunn; 'You're' by Sylvia Plath; 'Cold Knap Lake' by Gillian Clarke; 'My First Weeks' by Sharon Olds; 'Venus's-flytraps' by Yusef Komunyakaa; 'Love' by Kate Clanchy; 'Happy Birthday Moon' by Raymond Antrobus; 'Prayer' by Zaffar Kunial; 'Tea With Our Grandmothers' by Warsan Shire; 'Equilibrium' by Theresa Lola. Any other poem named as an anthology poem is out of scope, including the five withdrawn in Version 2 ('When I have fears that I may cease to be' by John Keats; 'Spring and Fall: to a Young Child' by Gerard Manley Hopkins; 'Ode' by Arthur O'Shaughnessy; 'Red Roses' by Anne Sexton; 'Farther' by Owen Sheers) and any poem from another board's anthology.
